pandas.testing.assert_frame_equal

pandas 3.1.1 · Testing, errors, and warnings · function

Compare expected and actual DataFrames in a test, with options for labels, dtypes and numeric tolerances.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(…) Full signature
pd.testing.assert_frame_equal(
    left,
    right,
    check_dtype=True,
    check_index_type='equiv',
    check_column_type='equiv',
    check_frame_type=True,
    check_names=True,
    by_blocks=False,
    check_exact=…,
    check_datetimelike_compat=False,
    check_categorical=True,
    check_like=False,
    check_freq=…,
    check_flags=True,
    rtol=…,
    atol=…,
    obj='DataFrame',
)
